pkg.r10.desc: Our best-value residential package. This is a full-service job: we review your actual energy usage, look at when you draw power, and size the array and the 27 kWh battery around how your household really runs rather than a number off a price list.
pkg.r10.for: Larger family homes · ducted air-con, pool
pkg.r10.note: Fully installed including a 27 kWh SigEnergy battery system. Estimated saving up to ~$4,400 a year, depending on your bill.
pkg.r10.summary: Our best-value residential system. Full-service: we review your energy usage and size the array and battery around how you actually live.
pkg.r13.desc: Outstanding performance for homes that run hard — multiple air-conditioners, a pool, a workshop, or an electric car in the garage. The 36 kWh battery gives enough storage to carry a heavy evening load.
pkg.r13.note: Fully installed including a high-capacity SigEnergy battery system. Estimated saving up to ~$5,700 a year, depending on your bill.
pkg.r13.summary: Outstanding performance for households that run hard, with enough storage to carry a heavy evening load.
pkg.r66.desc: The most common system in Australia, now paired with storage. A 6.6kW array covers the daytime load of an average household, and the 13.5 kWh Tesla Powerwall 3 holds the surplus for the evening instead of exporting it for a few cents.
pkg.r66.note: Fully installed including a Tesla Powerwall battery system. Estimated saving up to ~$2,800 a year, depending on your bill.
pkg.r66.summary: The Australian standard, now with storage. Daytime surplus charges the battery instead of being exported for a few cents.
